jobs.title: Research Lead, Evaluations
jobs.description: About Black Forest Labs We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world. Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use. Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next. Why This Role BFL’s research organization is split into different focus areas, such as pre-training, post-training, reinforcement learning, data, representation learning, evaluations and more. During the day to day work, researchers from these different focus areas work together to solve exciting and hard problems towards solving visual intelligence. Having the right means to measure what matters is the central starting point for every research project. Researchers make decisions based on the outcomes of evaluations. The right decision can only be made if an evaluation is precise and accurate. As the Evaluations Lead you’re the core driver to ensure that. Central responsibilities include building our eval roadmap in collaboration with the research and product teams, managing and extending our evaluation team, and cross-functional work with project leads to make sure each research project has the best evaluation toolbox to help the people working on it to make the right decisions. Finally, you’re responsible for growing the people in your team and maintain an eye on their long term development during the daily project work. jobs.description: We’re looking for a talented and highly experienced Senior Match 3 Level Designer to join our lovely and ambitious game team and help craft fun, rewarding and memorable puzzle experiences for our cozy mobile game. You’ll own the match-3 gameplay experience, helping to define the game’s level design framework while delivering best-in-class levels that strike the right balance of challenge, progression and delight. From core gameplay tuning and mechanic development through to polished, data-informed level iterations, you’ll take ownership of the player experience and continually raise the quality bar. You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience. As a senior member of the team, you’ll also help shape our level production strategy, driving quality with both internal development and external partners while contributing to the long-term direction of the game. What You'll Be Doing Design, build and balance exceptional match-3 levels that deliver engaging gameplay across a wide range of player skill levels. jobs.description: About us At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. The role Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer. You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients. You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it.
